messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- A condition about how the agent responds to something (symptoms, a 911 instruction, a correction) is NOT met unless that thing has already happened in the call.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi honey, this is Tess Morgan. I want to switch to the Riverside store, it's closer to my house.
AGENT: Hi Tess! I'd be happy to help you switch to the Riverside store. Let me just verify your information first—what's your date of birth?
CALLER: January 19th, 1974, honey.
AGENT (LATEST): Thank you! Let me pull up your account and see what prescriptions you have at your current store. Great! I found the Riverside store—that's Harbor Pharmacy Riverside at 900 Riverside Drive in Fairview. You currently have five active prescriptions at your home store. I can set Riverside as your new default store and move those prescriptions over for you. Does that sound good?  [system actions: verify_identity, list_prescriptions, find_stores]

CONDITIONS:
asked_2: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Wants all active prescriptions moved"
stop_0: Agent confirms H-702 is her default and her active Rx are moved.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"asked_2": {"met": true, "why": "Agent asks if moving all active prescriptions sounds good."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent asks for confirmation, hasn't confirmed move yet."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
